name: clockwork-tracking
title: Clockwork Time Tracking
description: Track time in Clockwork Pro for Jira directly from Raycast
author: gogoisprograming

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Get from: Jira > Apps > Clockwork > API Tokens (or visit {your-jira}/plugins/servlet/ac/clockwork-cloud/clockwork-api-tokens)

preferences.name: accountId
preferences.title: Jira Account ID (Optional)
preferences.description: Find in Jira: click your avatar > Profile > copy ID from URL after /people/. Filters worklogs to only yours.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Clockwork Menu Bar
commands.description: Shows current tracking status in the menu bar

commands.name: start-tracking
commands.title: Start Tracking Time
commands.description: Start tracking time for a Jira issue

commands.name: stop-tracking
commands.title: Stop Tracking Time
commands.description: Stop the current time tracking session

commands.name: view-time-entries
commands.title: View Time Entries
commands.description: View recent time entries and worklogs

commands.name: open-current-issue
commands.title: Open Current Issue
commands.description: Open the currently tracked issue in browser

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
